name: MailPierInboxWait
friendlyName: MailPier Inbox: wait for email or webhook
description: Waits for an email to a MailPier Inbox address (sets MailPierInbox.Code, .Link, .MessageId) or for a request to the environment's webhook URL (sets MailPierInbox.Webhook.Id, .Method, .Path, .Body). Fails the step when nothing arrives in time.
author: Solutions Group Unlimited, LLC
